class LoopDetectionAndChaining(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """Tests for repeated-action loop warnings, stale-ID chaining protection, and stuck-tab renewal."""

    async def test_repeating_same_action_on_unchanged_page_injects_loop_warning_on_third_repeat(self):
        tab = FakeTab(change_on_fill=False)
        replies = [
            {"thought": "try 1", "actions": [{"do": "fill", "id": 1, "text": "Same"}]},
            {"thought": "try 2", "actions": [{"do": "fill", "id": 1, "text": "Same"}]},
            {"thought": "try 3", "actions": [{"do": "fill", "id": 1, "text": "Same"}]},
            {"thought": "stop", "actions": [{"do": "done", "summary": "stopped"}]},
        ]
        asked = []

        async def model(messages, **kwargs):
            asked.append(messages[-1]["content"])
            return replies.pop(0)

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", model):
            outcome = await Agent("loop-test", tab, "system", lambda: "job", max_steps=6).run()
        self.assertTrue(outcome["done"])
        self.assertNotIn("You have sent the same actions three times", asked[2])
        self.assertIn("You have sent the same actions three times with the same result", asked[3])

    async def test_actions_after_a_navigating_action_are_skipped_because_ids_are_stale(self):
        tab = FakeTab(change_on_fill=True)

        async def click(aid):
            tab.view = 'url: http://portal.test/step2\ntitle: Step 2\n[9] button "Next"'
            tab.page.url = "http://portal.test/step2"
            return f"clicked [{aid}]"

        tab.click = click
        replies = [
            {"thought": "click then fill", "actions": [
                {"do": "click", "id": 1},
                {"do": "fill", "id": 9, "text": "stale"},
            ]},
            {"thought": "done", "actions": [{"do": "done", "summary": "ok"}]},
        ]
        asked = []

        async def model(messages, **kwargs):
            asked.append(messages[-1]["content"])
            return replies.pop(0)

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", model):
            outcome = await Agent("chain-test", tab, "system", lambda: "job", max_steps=4).run()
        self.assertTrue(outcome["done"])
        self.assertIn("the page changed, its ids are stale", asked[1])

    async def test_two_consecutive_navigation_failures_trigger_tab_renew(self):
        tab = FakeTab(change_on_fill=False)
        renew_calls = []

        async def failing_click(aid):
            return f"click [{aid}] failed: Page.click: net::ERR_ABORTED; maybe frame was detached?"

        async def renew():
            renew_calls.append(True)
            tab.view = 'url: http://portal.test\ntitle: Fresh\n[1] button "Retry"'
            return tab.view

        tab.click = failing_click
        tab.renew = renew
        replies = [
            {"thought": "click 1", "actions": [{"do": "click", "id": 1}]},
            {"thought": "click 2", "actions": [{"do": "click", "id": 1}]},
            {"thought": "done", "actions": [{"do": "done", "summary": "recovered"}]},
        ]
        asked = []

        async def model(messages, **kwargs):
            asked.append(messages[-1]["content"])
            return replies.pop(0)

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", model):
            outcome = await Agent("renew-test", tab, "system", lambda: "job", max_steps=5).run()
        self.assertTrue(outcome["done"])
        self.assertEqual(len(renew_calls), 1)
        self.assertIn("this tab kept failing to load, so it was replaced by a fresh one", asked[2])


class TokenCutOffAndTeamWakeup(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """Tests for LLM token-cutoff retry doubling and Agent idle/wakeup lifecycle."""

    async def test_chat_json_doubles_max_tokens_when_finish_reason_is_length(self):
        requested_tokens = []

        class FakeCompletions:
            async def create(self, **kwargs):
                requested_tokens.append(kwargs.get("max_tokens"))
                if len(requested_tokens) == 1:
                    choice = SimpleNamespace(
                        finish_reason="length",
                        message=SimpleNamespace(content='{"answers": [{"number": "Q-1"'),
                    )
                else:
                    choice = SimpleNamespace(
                        finish_reason="stop",
                        message=SimpleNamespace(content='{"answers": [{"number": "Q-1"}]}'),
                    )
                return SimpleNamespace(
                    usage=SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=100, completion_tokens=50, prompt_tokens_details=None),
                    choices=[choice],
                )

        fake_client = SimpleNamespace(chat=SimpleNamespace(completions=FakeCompletions()))
        gate = llm.asyncio.Semaphore(4)

        async def fast_sleep(_):
            return None

        with patch.object(llm, "_session", return_value=(fake_client, gate)), \
             patch.object(llm.asyncio, "sleep", fast_sleep):
            result = await llm.chat_json([{"role": "user", "content": "extract"}], max_tokens=8000, label="extract:clarifications")
        self.assertEqual(result, {"answers": [{"number": "Q-1"}]})
        self.assertEqual(requested_tokens, [8000, 16000])

    async def test_idle_callback_holds_finished_agent_and_resumes_when_news_arrives(self):
        tab = FakeTab(change_on_fill=True)
        idle_responses = ["Open questions remain: data:MAT-101", None]
        replies = [
            {"thought": "pause until requirements arrive", "actions": [{"do": "done", "summary": "waiting"}]},
            {"thought": "now finish", "actions": [{"do": "done", "summary": "all done"}]},
        ]
        asked = []

        async def idle_hook(reason: str):
            return idle_responses.pop(0)

        async def model(messages, **kwargs):
            asked.append(messages[-1]["content"])
            return replies.pop(0)

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", model):
            outcome = await Agent("erp-test", tab, "system", lambda: "job", max_steps=5, idle=idle_hook).run()
        self.assertTrue(outcome["done"])
        self.assertEqual(outcome["summary"], "all done")
        self.assertEqual(outcome["steps"], 2)
        self.assertIn("Open questions remain: data:MAT-101", asked[1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

1: """Local scorer for the Atira RFQ challenge.
2: 
3: Re-implements the published point weights (docs: scoring.md, rule 29 of the brief) so an answer can be
4: scored in milliseconds against a golden answer, without a sandbox test run.
5: 
6: The golden answer is NOT in this repo: it holds scenario values and lives in the local-only docs/golden/.
7: This file holds no scenario values and is safe to commit. It is also outside starter-kit/, so it is never
8: part of the submitted package.
9: 
10: Usage:
11:     python tuning/scorer.py <answer.json> <golden.json> [--json]
12: 
13: Golden format: the answer schema plus an optional "_checks" object:
14:     {"withdrawn_qa": {"position": "01.02", "quantity": 40} | null,
15:      "metal_index":  {"position": "01.03", "field": "surcharge_per_unit"} | null}
16: 
17: Where the published rules are ambiguous, the choice made here is marked ASSUMPTION. Calibrate them against
18: the breakdown of a real test run (test runs show points per part) and fix them there.
19: """
20: 
21: from __future__ import annotations
22: 
23: import json
24: import sys
25: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
26: from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal, InvalidOperation
27: 
28: CENT = Decimal("0.01")
29: # Zero-width space, non-joiner, joiner, word joiner, BOM: the sites hide them inside identifiers.
30: ZERO_WIDTH = {0x200B, 0x200C, 0x200D, 0x2060, 0xFEFF}
31: 
32: # Points per part for a bid case (scoring.md).
33: DECISION, REFERENCE, DISCOUNT, TOTAL, ARITHMETIC = 5, 5, 5, 5, 5
34: CHECK_POINTS = 5  # each optional check (withdrawn Q&A quantity, dated metal index), when present
35: POSITIONS_BASE = 75  # minus the optional checks that are present
36: 
37: # Weights inside one position (sum to 1).
38: POSITION_FIELDS = {
39:     "material_number": Decimal("0.20"),
40:     "quantity": Decimal("0.15"),
41:     "base_unit_price": Decimal("0.15"),
42:     "surcharge_per_unit": Decimal("0.10"),
43:     "packaging_per_unit": Decimal("0.10"),
44:     "rebate_total": Decimal("0.10"),
45:     "unit_price": Decimal("0.10"),
46:     "lead_time_weeks": Decimal("0.10"),
47: }
48: MONEY_FIELDS = {"base_unit_price", "surcharge_per_unit", "packaging_per_unit", "rebate_total", "unit_price"}
49: 
50: # No-bid case (scoring.md): decision 75, reference 5, no positions 5, total of 0 15.
51: NO_BID = {"decision": 75, "reference": 5, "no_positions": 5, "zero_total": 15}
52: 
53: 
54: @dataclass
55: class Score:
56:     quality: Decimal = Decimal(0)
57:     parts: dict[str, Decimal] = field(default_factory=dict)
58:     notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
59: 
60:     def add(self, part: str, points: Decimal | int, note: str | None = None) -> None:
61:         self.parts[part] = self.parts.get(part, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(points)
62:         self.quality += Decimal(points)
63:         if note:
64:             self.notes.append(note)
65: 
66: 
67: def money(value) -> Decimal | None:
68:     """A money value rounded to the cent, or None when blank or unparseable."""
69:     if value is None or value == "":
70:         return None
71:     try:
72:         return Decimal(str(value)).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
73:     except InvalidOperation:
74:         return None
75: 
76: 
77: def same(field_name: str, got, want) -> bool:
78:     if got is None or got == "":
79:         return False  # blank = unanswered, earns nothing
80:     if field_name in MONEY_FIELDS:
81:         return money(got) is not None and money(got) == money(want)
82:     if field_name in {"quantity", "lead_time_weeks"}:
83:         try:
84:             return int(got) == int(want)
85:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
86:             return False
87:     return normalise(got) == normalise(want)
88: 
89: 
90: def normalise(text) -> str:
91:     """Strips zero-width characters and surrounding space: the sites inject them into identifiers."""
92:     return "".join(ch for ch in str(text) if ord(ch) not in ZERO_WIDTH).strip()
93: 
94: 
95: def arithmetic_ok(answer: dict) -> bool:
96:     """ASSUMPTION: 'every position, and a total that is their sum' = total_net equals the half-up rounded
97:     sum of quantity x unit_price over all positions, and every position has both numbers."""
98:     positions = answer.get("positions") or []
99:     try:
100:         line_sum = sum(
101:             (Decimal(int(p["quantity"])) * money(p["unit_price"]) for p in positions), Decimal(0)
102:         ).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
103:     except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
104:         return False
105:     return money(answer.get("total_net")) == line_sum

110:     if golden.get("decision") == "no_bid":

127:     golden_by_position = {normalise(p["position"]): p for p in golden_positions}
128:     for name in present:
129:         ok = _check_ok(name, checks[name], by_position, golden_by_position)
130:         s.add(f"check:{name}", CHECK_POINTS if ok else 0)
131: 
132:     share = Decimal(POSITIONS_BASE - CHECK_POINTS * len(present)) / max(len(golden_positions), 1)
133:     for gp in golden_positions:
134:         ap = by_position.pop(normalise(gp["position"]), None)
135:         label = f"position:{gp['position']}"
136:         if ap is None:
137:             s.add(label, 0, f"{label} missing or omitted")

139:         for name, weight in POSITION_FIELDS.items():
140:             if same(name, ap.get(name), gp.get(name)):
141:                 s.add(label, share * weight)
142:             else:

144: 
145:     # Extra or duplicate positions cost one position's share each.
146:     extras = len(by_position) + s.parts.pop("_duplicates", Decimal(0))
147:     if extras:

155:     ref_ok = normalise(answer.get("tender_reference", "")) == normalise(golden["tender_reference"])
156:     s.add("reference", NO_BID["reference"] if ref_ok else 0)
157:     s.add("no_positions", NO_BID["no_positions"] if not answer.get("positions") else 0)
158:     s.add("zero_total", NO_BID["zero_total"] if money(answer.get("total_net")) == Decimal("0.00") else 0)

162: def _index_positions(positions: list[dict], s: Score) -> dict[str, dict]:
163:     index: dict[str, dict] = {}
164:     duplicates = 0
165:     for p in positions:
166:         key = normalise(p.get("position", ""))
167:         if key in index:
168:             duplicates += 1
169:         else:
170:             index[key] = p
171:     if duplicates:
172:         s.parts["_duplicates"] = Decimal(duplicates)
173:     return index

176: def _check_ok(name: str, spec: dict, by_position: dict[str, dict], golden_by_position: dict[str, dict]) -> bool:
177:     """ASSUMPTION: the withdrawn-Q&A check compares that position's quantity; the metal-index check compares
178:     the field named in the golden spec (default surcharge_per_unit) with the golden position's value."""
179:     key = normalise(spec["position"])
180:     p = by_position.get(key)
181:     if p is None:
182:         return False
183:     if name == "withdrawn_qa":
184:         return same("quantity", p.get("quantity"), spec["quantity"])
185:     field_name = spec.get("field", "surcharge_per_unit")
186:     want = (golden_by_position.get(key) or {}).get(field_name)
187:     return want is not None and same(field_name, p.get(field_name), want)

190: def _num_equal(a, b) -> bool:
191:     try:
192:         return Decimal(str(a)) == Decimal(str(b))
193:     except (InvalidOperation, TypeError):

1: # From RFQ to bid
2: 
3: **Turn a public tender into a correct, signed bid without a person touching it.**
4: 
5: You work for a German hydraulics manufacturer that wants to bid on a public tender for hydraulic cylinders. What you need is spread over four websites: the tender portal, a supplier portal with the buyer's specification, your company's ERP and the sales inbox. They behave like real business software, with logins, popups, session timeouts and outdated documents. Your agent reads all of it, applies the bid rules and enters one priced, signed bid in the tender portal.
6: 
7: **What you can use:** Any model through our proxy, your own tools and prompts, and up to four browsers at once. A model does the work in the sandbox: it finds its way through the websites and makes the decisions during the run. No fixed scripts, no crawlers, no copied values, no person helping.
8: 
9: **How you win:** Your bid has to be eligible first. After that, the most accurate bid wins, and between equally accurate bids, the cheaper and faster one. The leaderboard uses the public data. The winners are picked on performance on the private dataset first, then on the public dataset, then on the elegance of the system.

42: ## The task
43: 
44: One tender, four German websites, one bid.
45: 
46: The agent produces: **One bid**. It enters the bid in the tender portal's configurator and signs it with a TAN from the webmail.

48: ## The websites
49: 
50: Each run gets its own logins, in the run's `access`. To look around yourself, use the scouting logins below. Expect what real business software throws at you: popups, session timeouts, outdated documents and look-alike records. Everything your agent needs fits on a 1280×800 screen.
51: 
52: ### 1. Tender portal (Vergabeportal, `tender-portal`)
53: 
54: - URL: <https://atira-rfq-tender-portal.kyora.run>
55: - Login: required; each run brings its own username and password in `access`
56: - Holds: The public tender, its bill of quantities, the bidder Q&A that changes quantities, and the bid configurator.

91: ## Public and private data
92: 
93: There are two datasets. The leaderboard uses the public one, on these websites. The final run uses a private dataset: the same jobs, bid rules and answer format, on different websites with other content and data. We pick the winners on three things, roughly in this order: performance on the private dataset, performance on the public dataset, and the elegance of the system.
94: 
95: - **Public dataset:** The leaderboard uses the public dataset (public-1), the websites and data you scout and test on. Each submission runs once on it. We don't publish the correct answer. Test runs and the scouting logins use it too.
96: - **Private dataset (the final run):** When the hackathon ends, we run each team's latest submission that passed review once by default, or best of three if the team opts in before the final run starts, on a private dataset. It is similar, not the same: the same jobs, the same bid rules and the same answer format, but different websites (other software, layout, navigation and site names), other content and data, and the information split differently across them. Your agent has to handle them as it finds them. That run weighs most when we pick the winners, so don't tune your agent to the public scenario.

98: ## Bid rules
99: 
100: The brief states these rules in full. Together they define exactly one correct answer.
101: 
102: 1. **Quantity:** The tender quantity, overridden by the latest clarification that changes that position.
103: 2. **Requirement:** The position's requirement in the specification revision marked current.
104: 3. **Material:** The active ERP material whose bore, stroke, pressure, mounting and certification match exactly. If a position has none, the answer is no bid.
105: 4. **Unit price:** The price condition valid on the scenario date, at the highest quantity scale reached, minus the approved discount, rounded half-up to the cent.
106: 5. **Discount:** The most recent approval from the sales director for this exact tender; otherwise 0 %.
107: 6. **Lead time:** The from-stock lead time when stock covers the quantity, otherwise the production lead time.
108: 7. **Total:** The sum of quantity times unit price, rounded half-up to the cent.
109: 8. **Decision:** Bid, with one entry per tender position; no bid with no positions and a total of 0 when a material is missing.
110: 9. **Partial submission:** Full credit requires every position, but the bid form lets you explicitly omit unfinished positions (Position auslassen / Teilpunkte). They receive no position points; completed positions retain their independent credit. Review lists the omitted position numbers. You must still sign and submit a bid; saving alone is not scored. A missing active material still calls for no_bid for full correctness; omission is a way to submit incomplete work, not a replacement decision rule.
111: 10. **Finding records:** The specification/data sheet names a Kataloggruppe for each requirement. Search the ERP for that group, then compare candidate attributes. Empty or over-broad searches do not list the catalogue; narrow to at most 20 results. Mail search combines words with AND: use the tender reference plus a subject/topic. Read the appropriate inbox/archive results. Opened pages and selected result sets may be extracted by helpers. Sites and positions can be investigated in parallel; no shared request quota or mandatory site order applies.
112: 11. **Agent requirement:** A language model must choose navigation targets, searches and relevant documents from observations at runtime and make the important decisions. Helpers may extract a selected page, parse a selected document, paginate a model-selected result set, calculate, validate, retry and fill forms. They must not autonomously discover and traverse the websites to assemble the complete task evidence before model-directed investigation. Multiple agents and parallel browser sessions are allowed.
113: 12. **Commercial clauses:** A tender Q&A answer may assign a position to a Konditionsgruppe. Resolve that key in the latest Konditionsregeln message for the exact reference from kalkulation@ plus the bidder mailbox domain. Its prose determines whether discount applies to base only, base plus mass surcharge, or neither; setup fees are always excluded. A group overrides the default rule, even when two positions select the same material. The separately reported surcharge is always BEFORE any discount. Positions without a group use the default base-only rule. The order-level approved percentage and its threshold calculation do not change.
114: 13. **Withdrawn answers:** A tender Q&A answer may withdraw (zurückziehen) an earlier answer by its number. Ignore the withdrawn answer's quantity change; the latest remaining change applies, otherwise the tender quantity.
115: 14. **Scoped amendments:** After selecting the governing full specification revision, read the tender Q&A for technical amendments naming that revision and requirement. Apply only the named attributes; all others are inherited. The latest dated applicable amendment wins per attribute. Amendments to other revisions do not apply.
116: 15. **Shared stock:** Sum final quantities of all positions selecting the same material. Stock must cover that entire sum for every such position to use stock delivery; otherwise all use production delivery. No partial stock allocation. Price scales remain per position, not per material sum.
117: 16. **Conditional discount:** The latest exact-reference director approval may require a minimum undiscounted net order value. Compute that value from final quantities and valid per-position scale prices before any discount and excluding mass surcharges and setup fees, rounded half up to cents. The threshold is inclusive. If it fails, use 0 %, without falling back to older approvals. For no_bid a conditional approval yields 0 %.
118: 17. **Units:** Tender and Q&A quantities use the position's stated unit. Convert Satz using the governing specification's pieces per set. Price scales, inventory, allocation weights and bid quantities all use final pieces. Carton rounding affects packaging cost only, never the bid quantity.
119: 18. **Pricing breakdown:** Base_unit_price, surcharge_per_unit, packaging_per_unit and rebate_total are optional and earn independent credit. All monetary answers are net EUR. Base, surcharge and packaging are per piece; rebate_total is the credit for the whole position. Enter 0.00 for a known zero; blank means unanswered. Do not feed rounded per-piece breakdowns back into the final formula.
120: 19. These calculation rules apply to both practice and private datasets. Missing calculation fields lose only their own points; signing an incomplete bid is supported.
121: 20. **Technical derivation:** For a requirement marked nutzbarer Weg, apply its scoped amendments first, then add twice the per-end reserve from the revision-specific Technikfreigabe. Match the resulting nominal stroke to the ERP. Do not change the other attributes.
122: 21. **Authority and time:** Resolve each key from the latest record no later than the scenario date, for the EXACT tender reference. Authorized subjects/senders (local part + bidder mailbox domain): Technikfreigabe/technik, Verpackungstarife/logistik, Terminfreigabe/logistik, Devisenfixing/finanzen, Rüstpools/kalkulation, Projektbonus/finanzen. A newer record replaces the older one; a failed quantity condition does not revive it. Unrelated references and future-dated records never apply.
123: 22. **Currency:** The valid condition names its currency and FX key. Normalize its price unit, select the per-position quantity scale, then convert with EUR per currency unit and HALF_UP to cents. This converted base_unit_price is used in all subsequent calculations and approval thresholds.
124: 23. **Packaging:** Q&A assigns the tariff key; ERP gives pieces per carton. Charge ceil(final pieces / carton size) cartons independently per position. Do not increase the bid quantity. Report packaging_per_unit in EUR, rounded HALF_UP; do not discount packaging.
125: 24. **Delivery:** Q&A assigns a commitment key. Apply it only if its material matches and pooled final demand for that material is within its inclusive ceiling. Otherwise use shared-stock delivery. A commitment may differ by position even for the same material.
126: 25. **Shared setup:** Q&A identifies pool members; ERP gives allocation mass (distinct from surcharge mass); the Rüstpools mail gives the one pool fee. Allocate by quantity × allocation mass using the cent-allocation rule in that mail. Add each allocation to that position's ordinary setup fee. Report surcharge_per_unit BEFORE discount, excluding packaging and bonus.
127: 26. **Project bonus:** The finance mail gives marginal percentage bands. Compute the eligible undiscounted EUR goods total, apply each band only to its portion, round the aggregate credit HALF_UP to cents, then allocate proportionally to eligible line goods values using largest remainders in cents (ties: ascending position identifier). Report rebate_total as the allocated EUR CREDIT FOR THE ENTIRE POSITION, not per piece; enter zero for nonmembers. This bonus is independent of discount clauses.
128: 27. **Final price:** Clause-discounted EUR base + clause-discounted mass surcharge + (ordinary setup + allocated shared setup + carton cost − allocated project bonus) / final piece quantity. Use unrounded per-piece components and round HALF_UP once at the end. Sum quantity × rounded final unit price for total_net. Rounded breakdown fields are reports, not inputs to that final formula.
129: 28. **Metal indices:** Select the latest exact-reference Preisindizes message from kalkulation@ plus the bidder mailbox domain. If the code lists validity windows, use the rate whose inclusive window contains the scenario date, not the last rate listed.
130: 29. **Scoring in bid cases:** Decision 5, reference 5, discount 5, positions 75 minus any additional checks, correct total 5, arithmetic consistency 5. When present, the withdrawn Q&A quantity and date-selected metal-index checks earn 5 points each. Within each equally weighted position: material 20%, quantity 15%, base price 15%, surcharge 10%, packaging 10%, project bonus 10%, final unit price 10%, delivery 10%. Each field is independent; optional breakdown fields can be blank. No-bid scoring is unchanged.

132: ## How a run works
133: 
134: Develop on your machine against the public websites with the scouting logins (`atira scout --env`), then test in the sandbox: `atira test-run` uploads your package, starts a test run and opens it live, or drop the package on [your team page](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/team). A test run lasts up to 2 hours on the public data and returns its score with the full breakdown. In the commands, `$ATIRA_TOKEN` holds your personal token (sign in with `atira login`, then `atira token`).
135: 
136: 1. **Start.** The run issues a token, the task brief and fresh logins for every website.
137: 2. **Read.** Your agent reads the brief, the rules and the answer format from the API.
138: 3. **Work the websites.** It works through the 4 websites in a real browser and gathers the facts.
139: 4. **Submit.** It enters the bid in the tender portal's configurator and signs it with a TAN from the webmail.
140: 5. **Scored.** The answer is checked against the one correct answer; quality, cost and time are recorded.
141: 
142: ### Develop locally
143: 
144: ```sh
145: eval "$(atira scout --challenge rfq --env)"   # logins for the public websites
146: curl "$ATIRA_API/v1/challenges/rfq/scouting"   # the same, with the brief, as JSON
147: # run your agent on your machine, then once in the sandbox:
148: atira test-run ./my-agent --challenge rfq
149: ```
150: 
151: `atira scout --env` exports the scouting logins as `CHALLENGE_SITE_ACCESS` (the shape a run gets), each website's URL, and `CHALLENGE_SCOUTING`, the brief and the answer format. It also points the free hosted models at `atira models proxy` on your computer, so your agent needs no model key; another provider takes your own. Nothing done there counts. With these logins, an answer entered on the tender portal is acknowledged but never counts. In a run, your agent reads the same at `GET /v1/runs/current` with the run token as `x-api-key`, and hands in one valid answer of up to 65,536 bytes; a malformed one returns its problems while the clock keeps running.

159: ```

Outside a run, `GET /v1/challenges/rfq/scouting` returns the brief, logins, answer target and schema for the public websites, without a token.

31: INVESTIGATOR = """You are one of several research agents preparing a tender bid for a manufacturer's sales
32: engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
33: in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
34: you never calculate prices.
35: 
36: TASK BRIEF (the rules are authoritative)
37: {brief}
38: END OF BRIEF
39: 
40: {actions}
41: Case-file actions:
42:   {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
43:       File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
44:       evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
45:         positions         the tender's bill of quantities
46:         clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
47:         revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
48:         requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
49:         material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
50:         price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
51:         mail              an opened mail message
52:   {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
53:       Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
54:       complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.
55: 
56: How to work
57: - Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
58:   the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
59: - You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
60:   whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind.
61: - File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
62:   For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it.
63: - The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
64:   previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
65:   references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
66:   counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.
67: - Follow the search hints a website gives. If a search returns nothing or too much, change the search terms.
68: - When a question asks for every item in a list, inspect its page controls and use collect on the control that
69:   advances that list before filing it. Check the resulting page count or end state; do not mark a list complete after
70:   seeing only its first page. If the list is inside an embedded document, use the controls belonging to that document.
71: - For mailbox questions, search relevant folders separately when mailbox search covers only the current folder;
72:   include the archive when looking for historical or latest records. If a query is too broad or returns nothing,
73:   refine the terms and try again. Open candidate messages and file the message itself, not only its hit row.
74: - If the news says extraction failed or found no usable records, do not mark that question complete. Reopen the
75:   evidence page, check that it contains the records requested, and file it again with the right kind.
76: - When no open question is left that your website can answer right now, finish with done, also when you need
77:   facts the other agents have not filed yet. You are called again as soon as the case file brings new questions.
78:   Never idle with wait and never browse around to pass the time.
79: """
80: 
81: 
82: class Team:
83:     """Holds an agent that has nothing to do until the case file brings news, and ends the investigation when every
84:     agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""
85: 
86:     def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
87:         self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
88:         self.idle: set[str] = set()
89:         self.finished = asyncio.Event()
90: 
91:     def hook(self, name: str):
92:         async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
93:             version = self.case.version
94:             before = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()}
95:             self.idle.add(name)
96:             try:
97:                 while not self.finished.is_set() and time.time() < self.deadline:
98:                     changed = await self.case.wait_change(version, 1.0)
99:                     if self.finished.is_set():
100:                         break
101:                     if changed:
102:                         version = self.case.version
103:                         fresh = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()} - before
104:                         if fresh or self.case.news.get(name):
105:                             return "The case file has news" + (f"; new open questions: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}" if fresh else "") + "."
106:                     elif self.idle == self.names and self.case.pending == 0:
107:                         self.finished.set()
108:                 return None
109:             finally:
110:                 self.idle.discard(name)
111:         return hold

115:     name = tab.site_id
116:     system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

119:         questions = case.questions()

122:         text += "\n".join(f"- [{qid}] {question}" for qid, question in questions) or "(none)"

125:         if case.pending:

127:         return text

44: - "decision" is "bid" or "no_bid". A no_bid has no positions and a total of zero: take the form's way of
45:   declining, and still sign and submit it.
46: - "positions" has one entry per tender position that is offered. Enter each under its own position number.
47: - "material" describes the offered product, for forms that make you pick or configure it: choose what equals
48:   these values.
49: - Amounts are net EUR, written here with a decimal point and without thousands separators. A field may expect
50:   another notation (a decimal comma, a unit, whole numbers for weeks and pieces): follow its hints, placeholder
51:   and error messages. Change the notation only, never the value.
52: - null means the value is not known: leave that field empty. 0 or 0.00 is a known zero: enter it.
53: - "omitted_positions" could not be priced. Never invent values for them: use the form's explicit way of leaving
54:   a position out, if it has one.
55: 
56: {actions}
57: One more action:
58:   {{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "<what you need and how to recognise it>"}}
59:       A colleague who has the bidder's mailbox open in another browser looks for it and answers. This is how you
60:       get the signing code (TAN) the portal sends by mail. Ask only after you have triggered the code in the
61:       portal, and pass on what you know about it (the tender reference, that you requested it just now, anything
62:       the portal displayed about it): the mailbox also holds older codes that no longer work.
63:   {{"do": "check_submission"}}
64:       Read the current review page and produce a no-model checklist of visible errors, unfilled required controls,
65:       tender reference, offered positions and total. Run this immediately before the irreversible final step.
66:   {{"do": "finalize", "id": 12}}
67:       Press the final submit/confirm control only after check_submission reported READY. Never use ordinary click for
68:       the irreversible final submit control.
69: 
70: How to work
71: - Start from the page you are on and find the bid form of tender {reference}. Log in again if the portal asks.
72: - A bid form asks, in an order of its own, for things like the bidder's details, bid or no bid, the positions,
73:   the commercial terms, declarations, a review and a signature. Read each page and give it what it asks for,
74:   from the bidder data and the bid sheet. Fill every field the sheet has a value for, optional ones included.
75: - Read the form's own instructions: when entries are saved, what going back does, which fields are required.
76:   Do the fields of a page in one reply, then the control that saves them or moves on.
77: - After each step look at the result. If the form reports an error or did not keep a value, correct that field
78:   before you move on.
79: - Declarations: read what each one says. Give the confirmations a valid bid needs; leave unticked, or untick,
80:   options that would alter the bid or have nothing to do with it.
81: - On the review page compare what the form lists with the bid sheet: reference, decision, every position, the
82:   discount and the total. Go back and correct differences while there is time.
83: - Signing: trigger the code in the portal, get it with ask_mail, enter it and submit. A submission is final.
84:   If the portal rejects a code, request a fresh one instead of trying the same again.
85: - On the final review page, call check_submission. If it is BLOCKED, correct the reported issue and check again.
86:   Use finalize for the final irreversible confirmation only after it reports READY.
87: - You are finished only when the portal confirms that the bid was received. Then finish with done and put the
88:   confirmation (its receipt number or code, else its wording) in "answer". If you cannot submit, finish with
89:   done without "answer" and say why in "summary".
90: - Watch the time. A bid that is entered but not submitted scores nothing; a submitted bid with positions left
91:   out keeps the points of the positions it holds. When the head of a turn says time is short, do as it says.
92: """
93: 
94: COURIER = """You have the sales mailbox of a bidding company open in the webmail "{site}" at {url}, in your own
95: browser tab. A colleague is entering the company's bid for tender {reference} in the tender portal right now and
96: asks you for something from the mailbox, usually the one-time signing code (TAN) the portal has just mailed.
97: 
98: {actions}
99: 
100: How to work
101: - The request heads every turn, together with the answers you gave earlier in this run.
102: - Codes expire. The mailbox can hold older codes, codes for other tenders whose references look alike, and
103:   unrelated mail with similar subjects. The one that counts is the newest message that matches the request. Open
104:   the message itself and check its reference and time before you answer: a row in a list is not enough.
105: - Lists can be paged, sorted either way and split over folders, and new mail may only show after a reload. If the
106:   message is not there yet, reload and look again a few times.
107: - Log in again if the webmail asks.
108: - Finish with done and put ONLY the value asked for in "answer": a code exactly as written, nothing around it.
109:   If you cannot find it, finish with done without "answer" and say in "summary" what you saw instead.
110: """
111: 
112: 
113: def _amount(value: Decimal | None) -> str | None:
114:     return None if value is None else f"{value:.2f}"
115: 
116: 
117: def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
118:     """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
119:     position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
120:     positions = []
121:     for line in bid.lines:
122:         material = line.material
123:         positions.append({
124:             "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
125:             "material": None if material is None else {
126:                 "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
127:                 "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
128:             "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
129:             "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
130:             "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
131:             "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
132:     discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
133:     return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",
134:             "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),
135:             "positions": positions, "omitted_positions": list(bid.omitted), "total_net": _amount(bid.total_net)}

152:     # a cold mailbox costs minutes when the signing code is waiting (sandbox test run 54c78c38).
153:     courier_tab: Tab | None = None
154:     warming = None
155:     if mail_tab is not None:
156:         try:
157:             page = await mail_tab.page.context.new_page()
158:             courier_tab = Tab(page, {"siteId": mail_tab.site_id, "url": mail_tab.base_url,

160:             warming = asyncio.ensure_future(courier_tab.goto(courier_tab.base_url + "/"))
161:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  no second tab: fall back to the investigators' one
162:             courier_tab = mail_tab
163: 
164:     async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
165:         task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()

167:             return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
168:         if courier_tab is None:

170:         if warming is not None and not warming.done():

172:                 await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(warming), 20)
173:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  the courier opens the page itself then
174:                 pass
175: 
176:         def request() -> str:

178:             if codes:
179:                 text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
180:                          "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))
181:             return text
182: 
183:         system = COURIER.format(site=courier_tab.site_id, url=courier_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
184:                                 actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
185:         courier = Agent("courier", courier_tab, system, request, deadline=min(deadline, time.time() + MAIL_BUDGET),
186:                         max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS)
187:         outcome = await courier.run()
188:         answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
189:         if not answer:

def _int(value) -> int | None:
    number = parse_number(value)
    return int(number) if number is not None else None


def _text(value) -> str | None:
    text = str(value).strip() if value is not None else ""
    return text if text and text.lower() not in ("null", "none", "n/a", "-", "—") else None


def _resolve_is_set(unit, flag) -> bool | None:
    text = (_text(unit) or "").lower()
    if text in _PIECE_UNITS:
        return False
    if text in _SET_UNITS:
        return True
    return flag if isinstance(flag, bool) else None


def _strip_physical_only_stock(text: str, data: dict | None) -> str:
    """Reject free_stock extracted from a plant-level physical summary that has not opened storage locations."""
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("materials"), list):
        return ""
    lower = (text or "").lower()
    has_physical = any(term in lower for term in ("physischer bestand", "einschließlich prüfbestand", "physical stock"))
    has_free = any(term in lower for term in ("frei verwendbar", "verfügbarer gesamtbestand", "freier bestand",
                                              "frei verfügbar", "unrestricted", "free stock", "available stock"))
    if not has_physical or has_free:
        return ""
    stripped = False
    for row in data["materials"]:
        if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("free_stock") is not None:
            row.pop("free_stock", None)
            stripped = True
    return ("physical stock includes blocked/inspection stock — open the storage locations / availability "
            "breakdown to find and file freely available stock") if stripped else ""

  "setup_pools": [{"key": "<pool key>", "fee": "<the pool's one fee, as written>",

Fill only the blocks the message's original text really contains; leave the others out. Take values from the
message as sent, never from a draft, preview or quoted template shown around it. One price index code can list
several rates with validity windows: give each as its own entry.""",

The local part is what stands before the @; null for a topic the brief names no sender for."""


def _int(value) -> int | None:
    number = parse_number(value)
    return int(number) if number is not None else None


def _text(value) -> str | None:
    text = str(value).strip() if value is not None else ""
    return text if text and text.lower() not in ("null", "none", "n/a", "-", "—") else None

        """True once the case file has moved past version `seen`."""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

        while self.version == seen:

            left = end - loop.time()
            if left <= 0:

        if kind not in SHAPES:
            return f'unknown kind "{kind}"; the kinds are: {", ".join(SHAPES)}'

        pages = [page for page in re.split(re.escape(PAGE_BREAK) + r" \d+ =====\n", text) if len(page.strip()) >= 20]
        folder = os.environ.get("AGENT_DOCS_DIR")
        if folder:
            os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
        fresh = 0
        for page in pages:
            digest = hashlib.sha1((kind + "\n" + page).encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
            if digest in self.filed:
                continue

            self.pending += 1
            self.pending_by_agent[agent] = self.pending_by_agent.get(agent, 0) + 1
            fresh += 1

            asyncio.ensure_future(self._extract(kind, page, source, agent, digest))

            return f"this document is already filed as {kind}"

            if data and summary == "nothing usable was found in it":
                data = None
                summary = (f"{stock_note}; no usable records were extracted" if stock_note

                summary = validation + "; " + summary
            if data:
                self.evidence.append({"id": digest, "kind": kind, "source": source, "agent": agent,
                                      "summary": summary, "validation": validation, "extracted": data})
            print(f"[extract {kind}] {source} -> {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)[:1800]}", flush=True)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            data = None
            summary = f"the extraction failed ({str(error)[:120]}); file the document again"
        if not data:
            self.filed.discard(digest)  # so that filing it again is accepted rather than refused as a duplicate
        self.news.setdefault(agent, []).append(f"From the {kind} document you filed ({source}): {summary}")
        self.pending = max(0, self.pending - 1)
        left = self.pending_by_agent.get(agent, 0) - 1
        if left > 0:
            self.pending_by_agent[agent] = left
        else:
            self.pending_by_agent.pop(agent, None)
        self._bump()

  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind.
- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it.
- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
  references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
  counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.
- Follow the search hints a website gives. If a search returns nothing or too much, change the search terms.
- When a question asks for every item in a list, inspect its page controls and use collect on the control that
  advances that list before filing it. Check the resulting page count or end state; do not mark a list complete after
  seeing only its first page. If the list is inside an embedded document, use the controls belonging to that document.
- For mailbox questions, search relevant folders separately when mailbox search covers only the current folder;
  include the archive when looking for historical or latest records. If a query is too broad or returns nothing,
  refine the terms and try again. Open candidate messages and file the message itself, not only its hit row.
- If the news says extraction failed or found no usable records, do not mark that question complete. Reopen the
  evidence page, check that it contains the records requested, and file it again with the right kind.
- When no open question is left that your website can answer right now, finish with done, also when you need
  facts the other agents have not filed yet. You are called again as soon as the case file brings new questions.
  Never idle with wait and never browse around to pass the time.
"""


class Team:
    """Holds an agent that has nothing to do until the case file brings news, and ends the investigation when every
    agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""

    def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
        self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
        self.idle: set[str] = set()
        self.finished = asyncio.Event()

    def hook(self, name: str):
        async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
            version = self.case.version
            before = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()}
            self.idle.add(name)
            try:
                while not self.finished.is_set() and time.time() < self.deadline:
                    changed = await self.case.wait_change(version, 1.0)
                    if self.finished.is_set():
                        break
                    if changed:
                        version = self.case.version
                        fresh = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()} - before
                        if fresh or self.case.news.get(name):
                            return "The case file has news" + (f"; new open questions: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}" if fresh else "") + "."
                    elif self.idle == self.names and self.case.pending == 0:
                        self.finished.set()
                return None
            finally:
                self.idle.discard(name)
        return hold


def investigator(case: CaseFile, team: Team, tab: Tab, deadline: float) -> Agent:
    name = tab.site_id
    system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

    def briefing() -> str:
        questions = case.questions()
        news = case.take_news(name)
        text = f"CASE FILE\n{case.status()}\n\nOPEN QUESTIONS\n"
        text += "\n".join(f"- [{qid}] {question}" for qid, question in questions) or "(none)"
        if news:
            text += "\n\nNEWS FROM YOUR FILED DOCUMENTS\n" + "\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in news)
        if case.pending:
            text += f"\n\n({case.pending} filed document(s) are still being read.)"
        return text

    agent: Agent

    async def keep(action: dict) -> str:
        document, source = agent.document()
        return case.file(str(action.get("kind", "")), document, source, name)

    async def answer(action: dict) -> str:
        # A completion action can arrive in the same turn as `keep`. Wait for the extraction
        # result instead of letting the model repeat a completion that cannot yet succeed.
        while case.pending and time.time() < deadline:
            version = case.version
            if case.pending:
                await case.wait_change(version, min(1.0, max(0.0, deadline - time.time())))
        if case.pending:
            return "Evidence extraction is still pending and the investigation deadline is near; do not repeat this answer action."
        return case.answer(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), str(action.get("status", "")), str(action.get("note", "")))
